notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
First release!
I am sad to say there are still some big bugs but hopefully those fixes will come in the near future. 

In terms of my own personal development, this is huge for me to get a game released on Steam.

Check it out, find a match maybe. Host for some time see if anyone joins. It's very fast. 

Bugs on the List:
Sound effects are not propagating correctly, client to server to clients. This is a multicast issue in Unreal I will work on first.
Capture pads aren't transitioning back and forth correctly. 
Client blue mana bar is bugged after getting level buffs.

Critiques from first beta tester:
Needs a damage indicator
Better announcement and time to see scoreboard at end of match
